objects.description:
[The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has deleted forensic artifacts to include prefetch files, defender diagnostic and support logs using both `del /f /q C:\Windows\Prefetch\*.*` and `del /f /q C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Support\*.*`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026)(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026) 
[The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also used a batch script named after itself (`<filename>.exe.bat`) to delete [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) and the batch script.(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)
